facilities.name: SIM Home
facilities.blurb: The Simulation, Integration, and Management Home, or SIM Home for short, is a project designed to be an advanced metering and observation environment in which one can see user behavioral patterns while monitoring energy consumption. This was used to develop two applications for users to track this information.

facilities.name: SIM Lab
facilities.blurb: CalPlug provides a testing service for manufacturers and utilities to obtain a power consumption and savings report before their pilot programs for specific prototypes. CalPlug hosts four individual demonstration labs that are set up as individual SIM labs (Simulation, Integration, and Management), such as the SIM living room and the SIM office.

facilities.name: 1 kWh Challenge
facilities._flag: Confirm whether the program is still on hold or has ended.
facilities.blurb: The One Kilowatt-hour Challenge was a community outreach program that was designed as an educational program where community members within UCI could learn exactly how much energy a kilowatt-hour is.

facility_rooms_note: Notable rooms: Engineering Lab (Room 4301) and Data Engineering ThinkTank (Room 4500). Floor plan image: /wp-content/uploads/clplg_space.jpg
facility_intro: CalPlug encompasses various facilities that ensure the latest in Plug and Process load research is going on. Notable rooms of interest include Engineering Lab (Room 4301) and Data Engineering ThinkTank (Room 4500).
